title: DJ Curated-Lane Tracklist
description: Canonical schema for tracklist.json in mixes/<lane-slug>/. Used for hand-curated lane collections (e.g. telugu-9xm-feels-v1, telugu-feel-good-upbeat-v2) harvested from multiple source playlists. NOT for tracklists extracted from a single YouTube DJ mix — see tracklist.schema.json for that.

_comment.description: Free-form provenance note. Optional but recommended.

mix_id.description: Slug or YouTube video ID. Matches the folder name under mixes/.

lane_profile.description: Path to the .claude/skills/dj-research-agent/reference/vibe-*.md profile this mix follows.

created.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when curation began.

popularity_floor.description: Optional human-readable description of the popularity floor applied (e.g. 'pre-2018 ≥ 2M views, 2018+ ≥ 10M'). Only present if the mix applies a floor.

tracks.description: Track order is meaningful — there is no separate index field; the array index IS the index.

artists.description: Composers + singers, comma-joined. null if unknown.

video_id.description: 11-char YouTube video ID. null if unresolved.

youtube_title.description: Full YT-side title — useful for fuzzy match across re-runs.

view_count.description: Raw integer (NOT '192.3M'). UI/code formats on render.

sources.description: Names of source playlists/sources that surfaced this track. Used for ranking by appearance count.

passes_popularity_floor.description: Optional. Present only when mix.popularity_floor is set.

why_in.description: Optional. Curator's freeform reason this fits the lane.

boundary.description: Optional. true = flagged for user review (lane-boundary call).
